description: This PHP test class verifies the behavior of the OpenIdUserIdentity entity within the OpenID authentication plugin for the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, creates an entity instance, assigns related entities and values, then asserts expected properties.

classes.name: OpenIdUserIdentityTest
classes.description: Test case class for the OpenIdUserIdentity entity, focusing on its core features and relationships.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test method runs, by loading fixture data.

methods.name: testEntity
methods.description: Creates an OpenIdUserIdentity instance, sets associated user and provider, assigns a user identity string, then asserts the correctness of these properties.
